title: LLM isolation: close the $HOME transcript gap and the Linux late raw-log gap before isolation.i4/i5 go to enforce
summary: X5 (#1133) denies raw output under .evolve/runs, but each CLI keeps its own transcripts in $HOME: ~/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl (508 directories on the host, 2026-10-26) and ~/.gemini. $HOME is readable and ~/.claude is writable (homeStateWriteDirs), so a claude cell can read the raw transcript of any other cell of any cycle. On Linux, bwrap masks only the raw files that exist at the launch. Review of #1133, MEDIUM-3 and the Linux part of MEDIUM-2. Spec: docs/architecture/llm-isolation.md §8.5 and §9.
fix: Add the manifest field home_reads (X9) and grant each cell only the home paths of its own CLI. Deny the transcript directories of the other cells: ~/.claude/projects except the own session, and ~/.gemini. On Linux, mask the raw-output names of the workspace for files that the bridge makes after the launch, or move the bridge logs outside the write path of the cell.
acceptance: A contract row: a claude cell cannot read a fixture ~/.claude/projects/<other>/session.jsonl in the test HOME
A contract row on Linux (bwrap): a raw log made after the launch is not readable by the cell
isolation.i4.stage and isolation.i5.stage do not go to enforce before both rows are green
